subject.title: [Feature]: Add threadPromptGuideline for customizable auto-generated Discord thread titles

question: Should Discord generated thread titles get a new channel-level `threadPromptGuideline` config field, and if so should it be supplemental guidance rather than a replacement prompt?
rationale: The requested behavior is useful and source-reproducible, but OpenClaw policy sets a high bar for new config surface and this touches a stable Discord channel feature.

options.title: Approve bounded supplemental guidance
options.body: Add an optional, length-limited field that augments the fixed title-only system contract without replacing it, with schema/types/docs/tests in the Discord plugin surface.

options.title: Defer the new config key
options.body: Keep generated title behavior on the current fixed prompt plus channel context and ask for stronger repeated demand before expanding config.

options.title: Fold into broader thread config design
options.body: Treat this together with adjacent thread/channel config requests so maintainers make one coherent naming/threading policy decision.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded supplemental guidance
recommendation.body: Add an optional, length-limited field that augments the fixed title-only system contract without replacing it, with schema/types/docs/tests in the Discord plugin surface.

likelyOwner.reason: They landed the base generated-title config feature and are the best history-backed owner for deciding whether to extend that config surface.
